composer.title: Compose product
composer.description: Build a draft for {{investigation}}. Sources are included only when you select and stage them. Nothing is sent to an AI provider.
composer.localDraft: Edits remain only in this composer until you save a draft note. Preview media is disabled; no embedded images or other media are fetched.
composer.classificationHelp: Inherited from the investigation, baseline, and all supplied sources; it cannot be lowered here.
composer.placeholders: Template placeholders and Jinja directives are preserved as editable text. They are not executed or automatically filled. Review them before sharing.
composer.heading: Heading {{level}}
composer.noSources: No available sources of this type.
composer.stagingHelp: Appends a literal source table; it never replaces section text. No sources are selected automatically.
composer.replaceMessage: Changing the baseline replaces your current sections and edits. This draft has not been saved.
composer.discardMessage: Your unsaved product edits will be discarded. Nothing has been saved as a note.
composer.prepareFailed: Could not prepare this draft. Your current entries have not been changed.
composer.fieldLimit: This field exceeds the {{maximum}}-character limit. No content has been truncated.
composer.baselineUnavailable: That baseline is no longer available. Choose another baseline.
composer.waitForSave: Wait for the save to finish before closing.
composer.addSectionFirst: Add a section before staging sources.
composer.staged: Selected sources appended to the section. Existing text was preserved.
composer.promptCopied: Section prompt copied. No AI provider was contacted.
composer.copyFailed: Could not copy the section prompt. Your draft is unchanged; select and copy the section text manually.
composer.saveFailed: Could not save the draft product. Your entries are still here. Try again; if it keeps failing, preserve your edits and reopen the composer to review the investigation.
composer.validation.fieldLimit: {{field}} exceeds the {{maximum}}-character limit. Reduce it before continuing; no content has been truncated.
composer.validation.singleLine: {{field}} must be a nonempty single line.
composer.validation.sourceCount: The composer supports at most {{maximum}} source items. Narrow the supplied investigation snapshot.
composer.validation.chooseInvestigation: Choose an investigation before composing a product.
composer.validation.classificationCount: The classification snapshot exceeds the 2,000-source limit including embedded indicators. Narrow the source snapshot.
composer.validation.generationTime: The draft generation time is invalid.
composer.validation.selectSource: Select at least one source item to stage.
composer.validation.sourceUnavailable: A selected source is no longer available in this investigation. Refresh the source selection.
composer.validation.sourceTextLimit: Selected source text exceeds the 1,000,000-character staging limit. Select fewer items.
composer.validation.stagedLimit: Staged data exceeds the 200,000-character section limit. Select fewer items; no content has been truncated.
composer.validation.addSection: Add at least one report section.
composer.validation.sectionCount: A draft can contain at most {{maximum}} sections.
composer.validation.sectionIds: Report section identifiers must be unique.
composer.validation.headingLevel: Section heading levels must be between zero and six.
composer.validation.documentLimit: The draft exceeds the 500,000-character document limit. Reduce it before saving; no content has been truncated.
composer.validation.baselineUnavailable: The selected baseline is no longer available. Reopen the composer.
composer.validation.classificationChange: Source classification has changed or the draft classification is too low. Reopen the composer before saving.
composer.validation.classificationUnveri: Classification settings could not be verified. Review the workspace settings before saving.
composer.validation.sessionChanged: The workspace session changed. Unlock the workspace and review the draft before saving.
composer.validation.settingsChanged: Classification settings changed. Review the draft before saving.
composer.validation.draftChanged: The draft changed before it could be saved. Review the draft and try again.
composer.validation.investigationUnavail: The investigation is no longer available for composing. Review the draft before saving.
composer.validation.baselineChanged: The selected baseline is no longer available. Review the draft before saving.
composer.validation.sourceChanged: A source was deleted, moved, or made unavailable. Review the draft and source selection before saving.
composer.selectInvestigation: Select a loaded local investigation to compose a draft.
